mapper.select: SELECT id AS achievement_id, code, name, description, image_url, NULL AS unlocked_at, NULL AS notified_at, FALSE AS selected FROM achievement WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_achievement ( user_id, achievement_id, unlocked_at, notified_at, selected ) VALUES (#{userId}, #{achievementId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL, FALSE)
mapper.sql: a.id AS achievement_id, a.code, a.name, a.description, a.image_url, ua.unlocked_at, ua.notified_at, ua.selected
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_achievement ua INNER JOIN achievement a ON a.id = ua.achievement_id INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.id = ua.user_id WHERE u.username = #{username} ORDER BY ua.selected DESC, ua.unlocked_at DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT FROM user_achievement ua INNER JOIN achievement a ON a.id = ua.achievement_id INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.id = ua.user_id WHERE u.username = #{username} AND ua.notified_at IS NULL ORDER BY ua.unlocked_at, a.id
mapper.update: UPDATE user_achievement ua INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.id = ua.user_id SET ua.selected = FALSE WHERE u.username = #{username} AND ua.selected = TRUE
